# RawClient type

A [RawExecutor](/api/pg-prisma/latest/pg-prisma.rawexecutor/) that can also open a transaction.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type RawClient = SqlPool;
```
**References:** [SqlPool](/api/pg-prisma/latest/pg-prisma.sqlpool/)

## Remarks

[installChangeTriggers()](/api/pg-prisma/latest/pg-prisma.installchangetriggers/) needs one so the whole reconciliation — the function, the added triggers and the dropped ones — either lands or does not.
